create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object to represent a finite state transducer with start and final nodes
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn graph with optional start and final state flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn graph and export it to a PDF file with symbol labels
union_gtn_graphs: compute the union of multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph
